source.history: Read the complete original changes_requested verdict. Both classes had one prior formal occurrence and remained open entering this review.

classes.evidence: The reserved-device pattern now constructs superscripts from code points, matching pinned S1 semantics. Independently matched retained serialized endpoint bodies to their actual source and checked code-point-generated path inputs. Native host GetACP was 1252; Desktop children report codepage 1252. With the common H3 harness, old H2 under the PS5.1 parent produces the named ENDPOINT_VALID_PATH_REJECTED failure for COM-U00C2/LPT-U00C2. Current H succeeds in normal en-US and focused tr-TR runs on both runtimes; COM-U00B9/LPT-U00B2 remain rejected.
classes.negative_control_limit: Old H2 under the PS7 parent fails only SOURCE_NOT_ASCII; its valid-path handshakes succeed. That static diagnostic was not credited as a behavioral kill.

classes.evidence: Verified all 28 retained report sets and 922 artifact links, including endpoint and fresh-wrapper scripts, CLIXML inputs, raw reports, captured output, commands, actual return codes, runtime and culture. Checked that nested artifacts lie outside their own measured/cleanup roots and parent cleanup ancestors. Actual payloads contain Boolean WhatIf=true; raw rows show System.Boolean, ambient false, early dry-run and zero imports. Positive handshakes retain both expected hashes. All 22 CX source/report/output/record sets resolve.
classes.negative_control: Independently compared the existing owned private copy with the original manifest: exactly one endpoint report is absent. Read-only validation reproduced MISSING_NESTED_ARTIFACT:endpoint-report:child\endpoint-out-0.json. The original report remains byte-identical.
classes.capture_limit: Merged child output is decoded text captured by the parent, not raw OS stdout bytes. Original script, XML and report file bytes are retained and verified.

h1_history.disposition: Historical native failures are not formal findings or current acceptance evidence.
h1_history.verification: Inspected the comment-aware token scan, case-insensitive dynamic-scope collision fixes, scope-shadowing positive control and nonvacuous WhatIf assertions. The original 25 IDs and ten semantic CX obligations remain; the four historically failing IDs pass in current retained native reports.
